note: Hub-level layout. `sections` are UCSC supertracks - the folders a reader sees in the track controls - and follow the data_type values used in docs/oridb_hub_candidate_datasets.tsv, so the browser's sections and the dataset census cannot drift apart. A section with no dataset in it is not emitted. `overview` is the one section open by default: it holds one canonical track per data type, so the default view stays the same size however many datasets the hub carries.
